description: Record a payment against a customer: pass customer_id and amount, and optionally invoice_id, currency (default USD), status (pending, completed or refunded; default pending), payment_method and metadata. It records the payment in Last Price; it does not charge anyone. Needs a claimed Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

currency.description: The currency code. Defaults to USD.

customer_id.description: The customer: its id, as list_customers shows it.

invoice_id.description: The invoice: its id, as list_invoices shows it.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

status.description: The payment status. Defaults to pending.

name: create_payment
